summary: Bridgeline Digital filed an 8-K to disclose entry into a Common Stock Sales Agreement with WestPark Capital for an at-the-market (ATM) offering of its common stock. The filing is a routine entry into a material definitive agreement for a shelf takedown, not a transformative event. There are no stated stake percentage, price per share, premium, or special-situation terms; the company may sell shares at prevailing market prices with a 3.0% commission to the agent. This is a standard financing arrangement, not an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or other special situation. The ATM program permits periodic sales over time with no obligation to sell, making it an ordinary capital markets activity.
